description: Enlarges JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or JPEG XL images 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN (AI that restores detail), on this machine. Transparency is kept. The first call installs ONNX Runtime (about 113 MB) and downloads the model (5 MB) into the cache.

model.description: general for photos (default), anime for drawings, cartoons and anime (faster)

name: image_upscale
title: AI image upscaling
